key_reasoning.reason: Two codebases joined by a shared contract: the CLI OTLP plugin (tool-fields.ts, claude-code-otlp.plugin.ts) stamps the dedicated fork_agent_id field that the API-side agent-call rule reads. On the API side a new shared abstraction (agent_call_attribution.py, with hook_row_sql.py extracted to break an import cycle) is consumed by the reader (Timeline, parent-request fallback), rollups (counts), ingestor (marking), dirty (range marking) and fork_attribution (slash-command pairing). Scored 5 on the API side alone and bumped to 6 because the event field is a cross-repo contract.

The attribution rule has many open edge decisions that are visible in the code: source precedence (field, then subagent.stop correlated by tool_use_id, then complete tool_response text id), ambiguous multiple stop ids blocking the text fallback, one-call-per-agent tie-breaking (source, first row, tool_use_id), and the parent-usage fallback bounded at the call's end with Task/no-tool_use_id rows out of scope.

No exact precedent for a single resolution rule shared by forward, reverse and CTE forms across five SQL consumers. Counts and Timeline attribution are correctness-sensitive, and the code records a performance concern (a quadratic per-call session scan, 37 s for 200 calls among 11 000 rows) that forced a MATERIALIZED single-pass CTE and a plan-proof marking query. A cut or ambiguous agentId must never become a key, and a row read incorrectly mis-attributes or drops usage. The diff adds parameterized edge-case coverage: live-dispatch gate, live foreground-agent attribution and run tests, and a 1261-line captured fixture.

26 files: API 13 modified (5 source, 7 tests, 1 guide) plus 2 new source modules and 3 new tests/fixture; CLI 5 modified (2 source, 2 tests, 1 architecture doc) plus 2 new fixtures. Well above the 16-file XXL threshold, though roughly half are tests and fixtures.

The producer (CLI hook/plugin event fields), the API repository/service layer and the SQL persistence reads and writes (reader, rollups, ingest day-marking) across two codebases. No schema migration and no new infrastructure, so held at XL rather than XXL.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped to XXL (6): the borderline total (26) with Component Scope at XL leans higher, and the fork_agent_id field is a contract between two codebases.
Technical Risk held at XL (5): performance-critical SQL (quadratic-scan fix) and attribution-correctness sensitivity.

Technical Risk edge-case auto-bump considered: enumerated edge cases (ambiguous stops, cut agentId, lost id to another call, never-ended call) are covered by new parameterized and live tests, so no extra bump beyond XL.
split_recommendation: Actual size XL (27) is borderline with the top of L (26) and was reached by leaning higher; roughly half of the 26 files are tests and fixtures. If re-planned, split by component (one repo per child), CLI first: (1) codemie-code: emit the dedicated fork_agent_id field and its fixtures/docs; (2) codemie: the shared agent-call attribution fragment consumed by reader, rollups, ingestor, dirty and fork_attribution, with the end-bounded parent-usage fallback. Do not split the API slice further: it is one coupled capability.
